answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using network latency tomography. Landmark nodes send cryptographic ping audits across a peer nebula, bounding agent locations by signal propagation speeds in physical copper backbones. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of leasing distinct geographic points of presence per identity, rather than spawning synthetic peers like a weightless zephyr.
